text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. How was it~? My very own 
'Dantsu-chan's Ultimate Relaxation 
Birthday Date Plan'...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It was so fun and soothing...! Thank you 
so much, Mirako-senpai♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep. Sleep in nice and late in the 
morning~ eat sweets~ soak to my heart's 
content in a spa hot spring~ and wrap it 
up with special okonomiyaki~...—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Looking back on it now... isn't 
this whole thing just "a complete 
indulgence of stuff to heal myself"?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's the exact same as usual! And here I 
thought today of all days would be 
different...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"P-Please don't be so down...! I feel 
totally comforted already!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~~... Dantsu-chan, there you go 
pampering me so gently again~~...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"No, really... Sometimes when I'm on my 
own, I lose track of how to properly 
unwind."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still, just spending time with you, 
Senpai, naturally soothes my heart, or 
rather—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So, seeing Mirako-senpai being her usual 
self is the best way for me to unwind... 
kind of♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
D-Dantsu-cha~n...! Wait, why am *I* the 
one getting pampered again~~?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm just telling the absolute 
truth~!
